# Copilot Instructions for WE DO IT ALL

Follow [../.copilot/COPILOT.md](../.copilot/COPILOT.md) as the primary project guide.

## Hard constraints
- Keep this a plain HTML/CSS/JS site.
- Do not introduce framework/build tooling unless explicitly requested.
- Prioritize local SEO, mobile UX, and conversion clarity.
- Keep business facts consistent (phone, service area, services, social).
- Avoid unrelated refactors.

## Verification expectations
- Check desktop and mobile layouts after meaningful UI edits.
- Verify CTA paths (call click, contact form behavior, scheduling flow).
- Keep canonical, OG, and Twitter metadata URLs aligned to `www.wedoitallnv.com`.
